# Upstage Console Docs

> Documentation for Upstage Console, Solar LLM, Document AI, Agents, API Reference, and partner docs.

## Docs

- [Delete file](/api/agents/files/delete-file.md): Delete a specific file.
- [List files](/api/agents/files/list-files.md): List all uploaded files.
- [Retrieve file](/api/agents/files/retrieve-file.md): Retrieve information about a specific file.
- [Upload file](/api/agents/files/upload-file.md): Upload a file to be used by an agent.
- [Create job](/api/agents/jobs/create-job.md): Run an agent with specific input files.
- [Retrieve job](/api/agents/jobs/retrieve-job.md): Retrieve the status and result of a job.
- [Chat completions](/api/chat.md): Create grounded, multilingual chatbots using Upstage Chat API—built for memory, tool use, and fast integration.
- [Document classification](/api/document-classification.md): Classify documents into any types from any document.
- [Embeddings](/api/embeddings.md): Get high-quality vector representations for semantic search, clustering, and multilingual classification using Upstage embeddings.
- [Groundedness checking](/api/groundedness-checking.md): Validate LLM answers with Upstage Groundedness API—check alignment with source docs to improve accuracy and reduce hallucinations.
- [Prebuilt extraction](/api/information-extraction/prebuilt-extraction.md): Plug-and-play extractors for IDs, receipts, and claims. Upstage prebuilt IE is fast, accurate, and tuned for production use.
- [Universal extraction](/api/information-extraction/universal-extraction.md): Extract structured fields from any document, instantly. Upstage’s universal API supports schema-free, zero-shot information extraction.
- [Asynchronous API](/api/information-extraction/universal-extraction/async.md): /api/information-extraction/universal-extraction/async
- [Schema generation](/api/information-extraction/universal-extraction/schema-generation.md): Detect field structure in documents automatically. Upstage Schema API accelerates automation with dynamic form generation.
- [Document OCR API](/api/parse/document-ocr.md): Extract text from scanned documents with Upstage OCR—highly accurate for Korean and complex layouts, even at low resolution.
- [Document parsing API](/api/parse/document-parsing.md): Parse scanned PDFs into structured HTML or Markdown with layout-aware accuracy. Ideal for unstructured business documents.
- [Asynchronous API](/api/parse/document-parsing/async.md): Process documents with up to 1000 pages asynchronously. Submit requests and retrieve results in batches.
- [Create response](/api/search/responses/create-response.md): Generate an AI response grounded in your documents using the file search tool.
- [Add file to vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/add-file.md): Add a file to a vector store for asynchronous indexing.
- [Cancel file batch](/api/search/vector-stores/cancel-file-batch.md): Cancel a file batch. Completed files are not affected.
- [Create file batch](/api/search/vector-stores/create-file-batch.md): Create a file batch to add multiple files to a vector store at once.
- [Create vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/create-vector-store.md): Create a new vector store.
- [Delete vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/delete-vector-store.md): Delete a vector store and all associated files and vectors.
- [List files in file batch](/api/search/vector-stores/list-file-batch-files.md): Returns a paginated list of files in a file batch.
- [List files in vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/list-files.md): Returns a paginated list of files in a vector store.
- [List vector stores](/api/search/vector-stores/list-vector-stores.md): Returns a paginated list of vector stores.
- [Modify vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/modify-vector-store.md): Update a vector store's name, expiration policy, or metadata.
- [Remove file from vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/remove-file.md): Remove a file and its associated vectors from a vector store.
- [Retrieve file batch](/api/search/vector-stores/retrieve-file-batch.md): Retrieves a file batch within a vector store.
- [Retrieve file in vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/retrieve-file.md): Get the status and details of a file in a vector store.
- [Retrieve vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/retrieve-vector-store.md): Retrieve a vector store by ID.
- [Search vector store](/api/search/vector-stores/search-vector-store.md): Search a vector store using a natural language query.
- [Translation](/api/translation.md): Solar supports multiple models for below tasks
- [Agents API](/docs/agents.md): Get started with Upstage Agents API.
- [Files](/docs/agents/files.md): Manage files for Upstage Agents.
- [Jobs](/docs/agents/jobs.md): Execute and manage agent jobs.
- [Document Classification](/docs/capabilities/classify/document-classification.md): No templates. No retraining. Upstage Document classification API classify document into user defined type from any document.
- [Document split](/docs/capabilities/classify/document-split.md): Learn how to split and classify multiple documents contained within a single file.
- [Document chat](/docs/capabilities/document-chat.md): Provides answers to questions using the given documents. Each answer includes accurate citations from the sources.
- [Embed](/docs/capabilities/embed.md): Generate multilingual embeddings optimized for semantic search, document clustering, and Korean-language vector understanding.
- [Extract](/docs/capabilities/extract.md): Extract key-value fields from documents with schema-free AI. Upstage delivers reliable results across industries like insurance and finance.
- [Confidence](/docs/capabilities/extract/confidence.md): Learn how to obtain confidence for extracted information to assess reliability and implement Human-in-the-Loop workflows.
- [Document split](/docs/capabilities/extract/document-split.md): Learn how to extract information from multiple documents contained within a single file.

- [Universal extraction](/docs/capabilities/extract/universal-extraction.md): No templates. No retraining. Upstage Universal IE API extracts structured data from any document type—instantly and accurately.

- [文書分類](/ja/docs/capabilities/classify/document-classification.md): テンプレートも再学習も不要。Upstage Document Classify API は、あらゆるドキュメントをユーザー定義のタイプに分類します。
- [文書分割](/ja/docs/capabilities/classify/document-split.md): 1 つのファイル内に含まれる複数のドキュメントを分割・分類する方法を学びます。
- [Document chat](/ja/docs/capabilities/document-chat.md): 与えられたドキュメントを基に質問に回答します。各回答には出典からの正確な引用が含まれます。
- [埋め込み](/ja/docs/capabilities/embed.md): セマンティック検索、ドキュメントクラスタリング、韓国語のベクトル理解に最適化された多言語埋め込みを生成します。
- [Extract](/ja/docs/capabilities/extract.md): スキーマ不要のAIでドキュメントからキーバリュー形式のフィールドを抽出します。Upstageは保険や金融など多様な業界で信頼できる結果を提供します。
- [Confidence](/ja/docs/capabilities/extract/confidence.md): 抽出された情報の信頼度を取得して信頼性を評価し、Human-in-the-Loopワークフローを実装する方法を学びます。
- [ドキュメント分割](/ja/docs/capabilities/extract/document-split.md): 1つのファイルに含まれる複数のドキュメントから情報を抽出する方法を学びます。
- [位置座標](/ja/docs/capabilities/extract/location-coordinates.md): 抽出された情報の位置座標を取得する方法を学びます。
- [Prebuilt extraction](/ja/docs/capabilities/extract/prebuilt-extraction.md): Upstageのプリビルトモデルで身分証、領収書、クレームの抽出を自動化しましょう。実際の形式と速度に合わせてファインチューニングされています。
- [Asynchronous API](/ja/docs/capabilities/extract/universal-extraction-async.md): テンプレートも再学習も不要。Upstage Universal IE APIは、あらゆるタイプのドキュメントから即座かつ正確に構造化データを抽出します。
- [Universal extraction](/ja/docs/capabilities/extract/universal-extraction.md): テンプレートも再学習も不要。Upstage Universal IE APIは、あらゆるタイプのドキュメントから即座かつ正確に構造化データを抽出します。
- [スキーマの作成](/ja/docs/capabilities/extract/writing-a-schema.md): /ja/docs/capabilities/extract/writing-a-schema
- [概要](/ja/docs/capabilities/generate.md): Upstage Solar で開発を始めるための概要ページです。最初の API 呼び出しからモデル選択、推論・構造化出力・Tool calling、本番運用の準備までを案内します。
- [API クイックスタート](/ja/docs/capabilities/generate/chat.md): Upstage Solar API で最初のリクエストを送信しましょう。モデルエイリアスを選び、シングルターンとマルチターンのリクエストを送って数分でレスポンスを受け取れます。
- [FAQ](/ja/docs/capabilities/generate/faq.md): Solar でテキストを生成する際によくある質問をまとめました。モデルの動作、リクエストとレスポンス、よく発生する問題の解決方法をご確認いただけます。
- [Reasoning](/ja/docs/capabilities/generate/reasoning.md): /ja/docs/capabilities/generate/reasoning
- [Structured outputs](/ja/docs/capabilities/generate/structured-outputs.md): 独自に定義した JSON スキーマでモデルのレスポンスを制約し、毎回同じフィールド・型・列挙値でレスポンスを受け取れます。
- [Tool calling](/ja/docs/capabilities/generate/tool-calling.md): AI のレスポンスから外部ツールを呼び出します。Upstage は、エージェント、ツール、自動化フローのためのリアルタイムで根拠のある呼び出しを実現します。
- [文書変換](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse.md): Upstage の AI でスキャン文書を変換します。レイアウト認識による抽出と多言語テキストをサポートする高速な OCR と変換機能を提供します。
- [API クイックスタート](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/api-quickstart.md): 複雑な文書を構造化された HTML や Markdown に変換します。Upstage API は多様なレイアウトや大規模で非構造なファイルを容易に処理します。
- [チャート認識](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/chart-recognition.md): 複雑な文書を構造化された HTML や Markdown に変換します。Upstage API は多様なレイアウトや大規模で非構造なファイルを容易に処理します。
- [Document OCR](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/document-ocr.md): スキャン帳票や画像から高い OCR 精度でテキストを抽出します。Upstage OCR はハングル、漢字、低品質スキャンに対応します。
- [文書変換](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/document-parsing.md): 複雑な文書を構造化された HTML や Markdown に変換します。Upstage API は多様なレイアウトや大規模で非構造なファイルを容易に処理します。
- [大容量文書の処理](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/handling-large-documents.md): 複雑な文書を構造化された HTML や Markdown に変換します。Upstage API は多様なレイアウトや大規模で非構造なファイルを容易に処理します。
- [入力要件](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/input-requirements.md): 複雑な文書を構造化された HTML や Markdown に変換します。Upstage API は多様なレイアウトや大規模で非構造なファイルを容易に処理します。
- [複数ページにまたがる表の結合](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/merge-multipage-table.md): 複雑な文書を構造化された HTML や Markdown に変換します。Upstage API は多様なレイアウトや大規模で非構造なファイルを容易に処理します。
- [Tips & FAQ](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/tips-faq.md): 複雑な文書を構造化された HTML や Markdown に変換します。Upstage API は多様なレイアウトや大規模で非構造なファイルを容易に処理します。
- [出力を理解する](/ja/docs/capabilities/parse/understanding-output.md): 複雑な文書を構造化された HTML や Markdown に変換します。Upstage API は多様なレイアウトや大規模で非構造なファイルを容易に処理します。
- [File Search](/ja/docs/capabilities/search/file-search.md): ファイルをアップロードしてベクトルストアを構築し、関連情報を検索したり、Responses API でドキュメントに基づいた AI 生成の回答を取得しましょう。

- [Managed Applications](/ja/docs/deployment-options/azure/managed-applications.md): マネージドアプリケーションを使用して Upstage Information Extract を Azure にデプロイし、仮想ネットワーク内で安全なプライベートデプロイを構成します。
- [Snowflake Native App](/ja/docs/deployment-options/snowflake/native-app.md): Snowflake に Upstage をデプロイして、データウェアハウス内で AI 機能を利用できます。

- [문서 분류](/ko/docs/capabilities/classify/document-classification.md): 템플릿도, 재학습도 필요 없습니다. 업스테이지 문서 분류 API는 어떤 문서든 사용자가 정의한 유형으로 분류합니다.
- [문서 분할](/ko/docs/capabilities/classify/document-split.md): 하나의 파일 안에 포함된 여러 문서를 분할하고 분류하는 방법을 알아봅니다.
- [Document chat](/ko/docs/capabilities/document-chat.md): 주어진 문서를 기반으로 질문에 답변합니다. 각 답변에는 출처에서 가져온 정확한 인용이 포함됩니다.
- [임베딩](/ko/docs/capabilities/embed.md): 시맨틱 검색, 문서 클러스터링, 한국어 벡터 이해에 최적화된 다국어 임베딩을 생성합니다.
- [Extract](/ko/docs/capabilities/extract.md): 스키마 없이 AI로 문서에서 키-값 필드를 추출합니다. 업스테이지는 보험과 금융 같은 다양한 산업에서 신뢰할 수 있는 결과를 제공합니다.
- [신뢰도](/ko/docs/capabilities/extract/confidence.md): 추출된 정보의 신뢰도를 확보하여 신뢰성을 평가하고 Human-in-the-Loop 워크플로우를 구현하는 방법을 알아봅니다.
- [문서 분할](/ko/docs/capabilities/extract/document-split.md): 하나의 파일에 포함된 여러 문서에서 정보를 추출하는 방법을 알아봅니다.
- [위치 좌표](/ko/docs/capabilities/extract/location-coordinates.md): 추출된 정보의 위치 좌표를 가져오는 방법을 알아봅니다.
- [사전 빌드 추출](/ko/docs/capabilities/extract/prebuilt-extraction.md): 업스테이지의 사전 빌드 모델로 신분증, 영수증, 클레임 추출을 자동화하세요. 실제 형식과 속도에 맞춰 파인튜닝되어 있습니다.

- [배포 옵션](/ko/docs/deployment-options.md): AWS, Azure, Snowflake 마켓플레이스를 통해 업스테이지 AI 기능을 사용할 수 있는 배포 옵션을 살펴보세요.
- [AI Agent Tools](/ko/docs/deployment-options/aws/document-intelligence-ai-agent.md): AWS에 업스테이지를 배포하여 AI Agent 기능을 사용하세요.
- [Sagemaker ML Products](/ko/docs/deployment-options/aws/sagemaker-ml-products.md): 업스테이지 SageMaker ML 모델을 Jumpstart를 통해 AWS SageMaker에 배포하세요.
- [Managed Applications](/ko/docs/deployment-options/azure/managed-applications.md): 관리형 애플리케이션을 사용하여 업스테이지 Information Extract를 Azure에 배포하고 가상 네트워크 내에서 안전한 비공개 배포를 구성하세요.
- [Snowflake Native App](/ko/docs/deployment-options/snowflake/native-app.md): Snowflake에 업스테이지를 배포하여 데이터 웨어하우스 내에서 AI 기능을 사용하세요.
- [AI 코딩 어시스턴트용](/ko/docs/for-agents.md): Cursor, Claude 및 기타 LLM 기반 도구와 같은 AI 코딩 에이전트에 최적화된 API 문서입니다.
- [API Reference Raw](/ko/docs/for-agents/api-reference.md): /ko/docs/for-agents/api-reference
- [File Search Demo Instruction](/ko/docs/for-agents/file-search-demo-instruction.md): /ko/docs/for-agents/file-search-demo-instruction
- [File Search API Reference Raw](/ko/docs/for-agents/file-search.md): /ko/docs/for-agents/file-search
- [시작하기](/ko/docs/getting-started.md): 업스테이지 콘솔 단계별 설정 가이드. 복잡한 인프라 없이 몇 분 만에 고성능 AI API로 빌드를 시작해 보세요.
- [토큰 카운팅](/ko/docs/guides/counting-tokens.md): API 호출 전에 토큰 사용량을 추정해 보세요. 업스테이지는 개발자가 비용과 프롬프트 설계를 최적화할 수 있도록 정확한 토큰 수를 제공해요.

- [Rate limits](/ko/docs/guides/rate-limits.md): /ko/docs/guides/rate-limits
- [리전 엔드포인트](/ko/docs/guides/region-usage.md): /ko/docs/guides/region-usage
- [Claude Code](/ko/docs/integrations/claude-code.md): 명령어 하나로 Anthropic의 Claude Code CLI를 Upstage Solar 모델로 구동합니다.
- [Hermes Agent](/ko/docs/integrations/hermes-agent.md): 설치 명령 한 줄이면 Hermes Agent를 Upstage Solar 모델로 구동할 수 있습니다.
- [모델](/ko/docs/models.md): 업스테이지가 제공하는 다양한 AI 모델을 살펴보세요. 텍스트 생성, 문서 처리, 임베딩, 정보 추출 등 비즈니스에 맞는 모델을 빠르게 비교하고 선택할 수 있습니다.

- [Document OCR](/ko/docs/models/document-ocr.md): /ko/docs/models/document-ocr

- [Prebuilt Information Extraction](/ko/docs/models/prebuilt-information-extraction.md): /ko/docs/models/prebuilt-information-extraction

- [Solar Pro 4](/ko/docs/models/solar-pro-4.md): /ko/docs/models/solar-pro-4
- [Groundedness checking](/ko/docs/others/groundedness-checking.md): Reduce hallucinations with Upstage’s groundedness check. Validate LLM output against sources and deliver trustworthy answers.
- [Translation](/ko/docs/others/translation.md): Translate across Korean, English, and Japanese with fluent, context-aware results. Ideal for global enterprise content and workflows.

- [스튜디오](/ko/docs/studio.md): 코딩 없이 문서 처리 에이전트를 만들고, 실행하고, 개선하는 업스테이지 스튜디오를 소개합니다.
- [에이전트 만들기](/ko/docs/studio/create.md): 에이전트를 시작하는 세 가지 방법과 스튜디오 화면·에이전트 빌더 사용법을 안내합니다.
- [버전과 배포](/ko/docs/studio/deployment.md): 설정 버전을 관리하고, 안전하게 운영에 배포하고, Agents API로 자동화하는 방법입니다.
- [실행과 결과 검토](/ko/docs/studio/feedback-loop.md): 에이전트를 실행하고, 결과를 읽고, 정답 데이터를 쌓아 퀵튠으로 스키마를 개선하는 방법입니다.
- [노드 설정](/ko/docs/studio/key-features.md): 스튜디오 에이전트를 구성하는 Parse · Classify · Extract · Instruct 노드의 설정 방법을 안내합니다.
- [모니터링](/ko/docs/studio/monitoring.md): 처리량·속도·안정성을 추적하고, Job 단위로 파고들어 원인을 찾는 방법입니다.
- [공유와 라이브러리](/ko/docs/studio/sharing.md): 에이전트를 링크로 공유하고, 라이브러리에 게시하고, 설정을 내보내거나 가져오는 방법입니다.
- [트러블슈팅 & FAQ](/ko/docs/studio/troubleshooting.md): 스튜디오에서 자주 겪는 문제의 해결법과 자주 묻는 질문, 용어집입니다.
- [활용 예시](/ko/docs/studio/use-cases.md): 노드 4개로 실제 문서 업무를 조립하는 대표 예시 4가지를 소개합니다.
